title: corynephorus canescens subsp. maritimus
intro: Corynephorus canescens subsp. maritimus, commonly known as maritime fescue, is a perennial grass species. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of maritime fescue include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it a possible remedy for conditions such as asthma and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
